title.zh: 单次各向异性反演试探

summary: Evaluate one forward equilibrium trial with a predetermined residual size, distinguishing valid, numerical-failure and nonconverged outcomes; contract errors are reported directly.

capability: Evaluate one forward equilibrium trial with a fixed-size residual protocol, distinguishing valid, numerical-failure and nonconverged outcomes.
operation: parameters and compatible physical ports -> residuals, chi2, equilibrium and valid/status
discovery.model: Validated composition of caller forward, diagnostic and residual ports with no built-in pressure closure.
discovery.geometry: Defined by solver_config and the scientific ports; diagnostic R/Z are deep-copied unchanged with no unit conversion.
discovery.boundary: The failure penalty is an optimizer-interface value, not a physical observation or feasibility proof; parameter ranges are constrained jointly by the outer optimizer and the physical ports.

identity.relation: parameters and compatible physical ports to a fixed-size validity record
identity.direction: params, observations, solver_config, three ports -> residuals, chi2, equilibrium, valid/status
identity.definition: Before any scientific call, obtain N from the standard observation layout or from an explicitly supplied residual_size on a custom port. Deep-copy the call inputs and execute one equilibrium_solver; if it is not converged, immediately return an N-vector positive penalty without running diagnostics. When converged, run the diagnostic and reducer, and check residual shape/finiteness and chi2=r·r. ArithmeticError/RuntimeError is recorded as a numerical failure; contract errors such as ValueError/TypeError/KeyError propagate.
identity.model: validated composition of caller forward, diagnostic and residual ports with no built-in pressure closure
identity.geometry: defined by solver_config and the scientific ports
identity.coordinates: r_grid/z_grid are deep-copied unchanged as diagnostic R/Z; no unit conversion is performed
identity.boundary: The failure penalty is an optimizer-interface value, not an acceptable physical observation or a feasibility proof. Parameter ranges are constrained jointly by the outer optimizer and the physical ports.
assumptions: The three ports have explicit and compatible physical units, grids and return protocols.
equilibrium.converged must be boolean; a successful state must not also carry failure_reason.
For a custom layout, the caller declares residual_size before the first trial; it must not change with success or failure.

inputs.name: params
inputs.description: Complete parameter mapping for this trial; deep-copied before being passed to the forward port.
inputs.constraints: The scientific parameter range is constrained by the forward relation and the outer bounds.

inputs.name: observations
inputs.description: Diagnostic request, observed values and uncertainties.
inputs.constraints: When residual_size is not supplied, this must be a known nonempty standard layout; N is the total number of elements in all requested values.

inputs.name: solver_config
inputs.description: Fixed forward configuration, which must contain r_grid/z_grid; params is replaced in the copy.
inputs.constraints: Inputs are deep-copied; the caller's nested mappings or arrays are not modified.

inputs.name: equilibrium_solver
inputs.description: Forward scientific solver with a single parameter-mapping entry point.
inputs.constraints: Returns a boolean converged; False immediately short-circuits diagnostics and records the reason.

inputs.name: diagnostic_evaluator
inputs.description: Diagnostic port called only after forward convergence.
inputs.constraints: Must supply predictions for every request, with units where necessary.

inputs.name: residual_reducer
inputs.description: Normalized relation that outputs residual_vector and chi2.
inputs.constraints: The vector must be (N,) and finite; chi2 must be finite and nonnegative and agree with the inner product at rtol=1e-12, atol=0.

inputs.name: residual_size
inputs.description: Predetermined dimension for a custom observation port; the standard layout usually supplies it automatically.
inputs.constraints: Rejects booleans, zero and negative values; the dimension cannot change within this call.

inputs.name: failure_penalty
inputs.description: Positive penalty applied to each residual component on numerical failure or forward nonconvergence.
inputs.constraints: Default 1e12; finite and positive, and N*penalty^2 must be representable.

outputs.name: params
outputs.description: Deep copy of the submitted parameters.
outputs.constraints: Port writes to the copy do not change it.

outputs.name: chi2
outputs.description: Recomputed inner product of the successful vector; N*penalty^2 on failure.
outputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative; a failure chi2 is not treated as a valid physical fit.

outputs.name: residuals
outputs.description: Successful residuals or a same-size penalty vector.
outputs.constraints: N is preserved on every success/failure path.

outputs.name: equilibrium
outputs.description: Forward state obtained so far; None if none was obtained before a numerical exception.
outputs.constraints: A failure record may retain a nonconverged state for diagnostics only; it is not an acceptable solution.

outputs.name: failure_reason
outputs.description: Explicit reason for forward nonconvergence or a numerical exception; None when valid.
outputs.constraints: Supply a generic explanation when nonconverged without a reason.

outputs.name: valid
outputs.description: Forward and residual contracts are both satisfied.
outputs.constraints: Only True permits the optimizer to rank this trial as a valid best.

outputs.name: failed_port
outputs.constraints: equilibrium_solver, diagnostic_evaluator, residual_reducer; None when valid.

outputs.name: exception_type
outputs.description: Actual class name of the numerical exception.
outputs.constraints: A nonconverged record without an exception is None.

preconditions: Before the first call, N, every port contract and a finite positive penalty are explicit.
supported: Deep-copy inputs, diagnose only after convergence, and keep a constant dimension across success -> failure -> success.
Stateful records for numerical failure and forward nonconvergence; inner-product consistency of residuals.
excluded: Hiding programming or contract exceptions as physical infeasibility.
Using a built-in penalty to prove model validity or to restore an unspecified physical closure.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for structurally invalid static inputs, ports or dimensions, or when a supplied value's conversion raises ValueError; TypeError when a conversion or nested port raises TypeError. Nested ValueError/TypeError/KeyError propagate.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: A nested ArithmeticError (including FloatingPointError) or RuntimeError returns numerical_failure with the same N, preserving the failed port and exception class. Process-level exceptions are not caught.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: A forward False returns forward_nonconvergence directly; diagnostics for that state are never executed.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Retains any actually obtained forward state for investigation with valid=False; the dimension is not lost and it does not participate in valid-best ranking.

python.signature: evaluate_anisotropic_trial(*, params, observations, solver_config, equilibrium_solver, diagnostic_evaluator, residual_reducer, residual_size=None, failure_penalty=1000000000000.0)

example.description: When a two-observation forward solve does not converge, diagnostics are not called and two penalties are returned.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.inference import evaluate_anisotropic_trial
from scirel.diagnostics import reduce_observation_residuals
calls=[]
r=evaluate_anisotropic_trial(params={'p':1.}, observations={'flux_loops':{'values':[1.,2.]}}, solver_config={'r_grid':[0.],'z_grid':[0.]}, equilibrium_solver=lambda _: {'converged':False,'failure_reason':'iteration limit'}, diagnostic_evaluator=lambda _:calls.append('unexpected'), residual_reducer=reduce_observation_residuals)
assert not calls and not r['valid']
np.testing.assert_array_equal(r['residuals'],[1e12,1e12])
assert r['chi2']==2e24 and r['status']=='forward_nonconvergence'
example.expected: N stays 2, chi2=2e24, and the state is explicitly nonconverged; no diagnostic is called.

scope: Fixed dimension and port records across success/numerical failure/success.
Nonconvergence short-circuit, rejection of wrong residual shape/NaN/chi2, and deep non-modification of the caller.
Independent analytic and curved-field forward inversion consumer.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Bounded to one forward equilibrium trial with explicit valid, numerical-failure and nonconverged outcomes. Evidence: `test_inference_physical_closure.py` contains 20 test functions, none of which references `evaluate_anisotropic_trial`, and is shared by 4 assets; `test_anisotropic_inference_independent.py` contains 1 test function, none of which references `evaluate_anisotropic_trial`, and is shared by 4 assets; only shared-file coverage is bound, so a pass is file-level rather than asset-isolated; the bounded example was executed by this audit. Oracle: independent analytic and discrete-reference comparisons in the bound inference files. It does not establish hiding contract/programming exceptions as physical infeasibility, or using a penalty to prove model validity.
known_limitations: The scientific meaning of RuntimeError belongs to the caller's port; the failure record does not replace investigation of the original exception.
A single trial does not judge parameter identifiability or optimality.
